name: Quacktory Quarterly — Static / Ducks.

tokens.--font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

direction_summary: Editorial magazine-cover composition. Cream paper field + deep teal block + ink dark accent. Heavy display sans wordmark with tight tracking; tiny mono caps metadata inset into the type. Vertical edge labels (rotated) and corner ornaments evoke a vintage print masthead. Size ladder as bottom rail with circular nodes + rotated edge labels 4cm→3m.
hero_pattern: Magazine-cover hybrid: warm cream paper upper third with halftone grain + deep teal block lower two-thirds with the wordmark 'ducks.' set huge across the width + integrated Mega-duck photo inside the teal block (studio plate duotoned onto the cover's own teal ramp so the backdrop continues the flat field and the subject isolates as a dark figure) that bleeds off the bottom edge + vertical barcode rectangle on the right edge + tiny inset metadata inside the type + corner ornaments in the cream field.
interactions: Hover lift on each product card (translateY + soft glow)
Click on size-ladder node opens modal specimen card (size/finish/SKU/price/notes)
Click on any product image opens the same modal pre-filled with that SKU
IntersectionObserver scroll fade for sections (cream field slides up from below)
Live 'Add to collection' counter in ghost-pill chrome (top-right) — increments on click
watchouts_addressed: Teal block and display type close in value — type is set in cream-white on teal (high contrast) and any inset metadata uses --ink for separation
Subject cropping at frame edge — Mega duck hero extends off the bottom intentionally as a 'design choice' callback to the crit, but the size-ladder rail ducks are fully contained
Decorative barcode — the right-edge barcode is now real SKUs (real product IDs, scan-readable proportions)
Decorative corner glyphs — kept minimal, treated as thin editorial line ornaments, not kitsch
